answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 671 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the pulse. The atlas index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the sonnet queue while honest participants promoted earlier continues earning. The deposit is 15 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
